info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Sentiment API

params.name: model-version
params.description: (Optional) This value indicates which model will be used for scoring. If a model-version is not specified, the API should default to the latest, non-preview version.

params.name: showStats
params.description: (Optional) if set to true, response will contain request and document level statistics.

params.name: opinionMining
params.description: (Optional) if set to true, response will contain not only sentiment prediction but also opinion mining (aspect-based sentiment analysis) results.

params.name: stringIndexType
params.description: (Optional) Specifies the method used to interpret string offsets.  Defaults to Text Elements (Graphemes) according to Unicode v8.0.0. For additional information see https://aka.ms/text-analytics-offsets

items.docs: The API returns a detailed sentiment analysis for the input text. The analysis is done in multiple levels of granularity, start from the a document level, down to sentence and key terms (targets and assessments).
